capabilities: compute sums, averages, min/max and counts over markdown lists
evaluate If() conditions and math functions like sqrt, LCM and GCD
count checked and unchecked checkbox items at every nesting level
resolve single values with dot paths such as Trip.Food.Dinner
export list data as JSON from a side panel
disambiguation: Not a visual spreadsheet editor; calculations run on ordinary markdown lists via ```listsheet``` formula blocks, with no table UI.
extras: Known bug: dots inside quoted text (e.g. "Mr.Smith") are misread as list references. V1.0.1 changes some results compared with V1.0.0 for nested lists and checkboxes. Loads the Hind Siliguri Bangla font from Google Fonts at startup; falls back to the system font offline.
intentEvidence: CListCalc plugin is officially disconnected (after August 30, 2026). Please migrate to ListSheet.
motivation: The author rebuilt the earlier ClistCalc plugin's regex-based list parsing as a Markdown-parsing engine that splits items into label, value, prefix and suffix, avoiding token mistakes and easing migration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute values from lists inside a note, so budgets, totals and checklist tallies must be calculated by hand.

summary: Formula engine that turns markdown bullet, numbered and checkbox lists into live calculations with sums, conditions, dot-notation lookups, and Bengali digit support.
